The gates used are the attachments' own printed totals: 83 contribution rows across p4+p5+p6 = 53,100.00 = the single grand total printed at the foot of p6 GATE PASS; 33 expenditure rows on p8 = 20,549.59 = the total printed at the foot of that table GATE PASS. itemized.notes: Peter Corroon, Mayor, Year-End Report January 31 (form checks 'January 31 of each year'; signed 1/31/07, clerk stamp JAN 31 2007). PDF pages 2-8 are a FAX (header '01/30/2007 23:27 8014844823 HEARTSONG ENTEPRISES', fax pages 03-09). THREE PROPERTIES TO RESPECT: (1) the Schedule A sheet's DATE column is EMPTY on 78 of its 83 rows - only five rows carry a date (6/21/2006, 7/7/2006, 8/1/2006 and two 8/24/2006) - so most contribution rows honestly have no date and are flagged needs_review; (2) its COMPLETE MAILING ADDRESS column is printed but empty on every row, so the filing carries NO donor geography; (3) the Occupation and Employer columns are filled for only part of the list and are preserved per row in the notes.
